description: Samples the three inverter phase-current channels from the platform current sensors.

outputPorts.name: I_A
outputPorts.description: Measured phase A current in amperes.

outputPorts.name: I_B
outputPorts.description: Measured phase B current in amperes.

outputPorts.name: I_C
outputPorts.description: Measured phase C current in amperes.

outputPorts.name: Diudt
outputPorts.description: Estimated phase-U current slope from the ADC sample burst.

outputPorts.name: Divdt
outputPorts.description: Estimated phase-V current slope from the ADC sample burst.

outputPorts.name: BurstTimeUs
outputPorts.description: Elapsed time in microseconds across the ADC sample burst.

InvertPolarity.description: Negate all three phase currents to match the FOC sign convention on hardware with inverted current sensors.
